review: DRAFT: needs a teammate's review. Drafted by Claude on 2026-10-19; these are team judgements, edit freely.

notes.sun_disc: Translucent gold circle behind the bottle; carries no information.
notes.copy_panel: Translucent card behind the headline and subhead. Too big to be a button, so it stays its own all-shape unit: decoration.
notes.product: The bottle, the only real image: hero. Second, as in the Level 2/3 goldens.
notes.headline: Largest type, the main message.
notes.subhead: One line of supporting copy under the headline.
notes.cta_pill: 'Shop now' on an orange pill. Nothing in this design is grouped; build_units pairs the loose shape and label into one unit with the shape's id.
notes.tag_dot: '4-PACK' on a red dot: a short promotional label. Last: it qualifies the product, but nothing is lost without it.
notes.logo: Brand mark, bottom-right this time. After the CTA, as in the other goldens.
